# Event Catering Agreement

Between Saffron Table Catering LLP (the "Caterer") and Brightwater Conference Centre Ltd (the "Venue").

## 4. Catering Standards

4.1 The Caterer undertakes to:
(a) hold a food hygiene rating of 4 or higher throughout the Term;
(b) provide allergen information for every dish served; and
(c) remove all waste from the kitchen by 23:00 on each Event Day.

4.2 The Caterer agrees to use reasonable endeavours to source at least 50% of produce from growers located within 50 miles of the Venue.

4.3 The Venue will provide the Caterer with access to the loading bay from 07:00 on each Event Day.

## 5. Subcontracting

5.1 The Caterer shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Venue's prior written consent.

question: By what time must the Caterer clear waste from the kitchen on an Event Day?
gold_citation_contains: remove all waste from the kitchen by 23:00

# Clinical Research Services Agreement

This Agreement is entered into by Halberd Clinical Research Ltd (the "CRO") and Veyra Therapeutics Inc. (the "Sponsor").

## 1. Definitions

1.1 "Trial Site" means each hospital at which subjects are enrolled in the Trial.

## 6. Conduct of the Trial

6.1 The CRO must report each Serious Adverse Event to the Sponsor within 24 hours of becoming aware of it.

6.2 Source data shall be retained by the CRO for a period of not less than 15 years after completion of the Trial.

6.3 The Sponsor may audit any Trial Site on 10 Business Days' notice.

6.4 The CRO shall not enrol more than 120 subjects in the Trial.

6.5 The CRO shall deliver the Final Study Report to the Sponsor no later than 31 March 2027.

question: For how long must the CRO keep the source data?
gold_citation_contains: not less than 15 years after completion of the Trial

documents.text:
# Managed Hosting Agreement

Stratocumulus Hosting GmbH (the "Provider") and Pellucid Analytics Ltd (the "Client") agree as follows.

## 2. Data Protection

2.1 The Provider shall back up Client Data every 24 hours.

2.2 Backups shall be stored in a geographically separate data centre.

## 3. Service Levels

3.1 The Provider will ensure that the Hosted Platform is Available at least 99.9% of the time in each calendar month.

3.2 Scheduled maintenance must be notified to the Client at least 5 days in advance.

3.3 Should Availability fall below 99.9% in any calendar month, the Provider shall credit the Client with 10% of the monthly Fees.

3.4 The Client shall not perform penetration testing against the Hosted Platform without giving 48 hours' prior notice.

3.5 The Provider may suspend the Services if the Client's usage poses a security risk to other customers.

question: What recovery time objective (RTO) does the Provider commit to after a disaster?

# Vehicle Fleet Lease

This Lease is made between Ridgeway Fleet Leasing Ltd (the "Lessor") and Marlow Couriers Ltd (the "Lessee").

## 7. Use and Return of Vehicles

7.1 The Lessee shall keep each Vehicle insured on a fully comprehensive basis throughout the Lease Term.

7.2 The Lessee shall not permit any Vehicle to be driven outside the United Kingdom.

7.3 Each Vehicle shall be returned with no more than 60,000 miles recorded on its odometer.

7.4 If the recorded mileage on return exceeds 60,000 miles, the Lessee will pay an excess mileage charge of £0.12 per mile.

7.5 The Lessor is entitled to inspect any Vehicle on reasonable notice.

## 8. Maintenance

8.1 The Lessor shall pay all routine servicing costs for each Vehicle.

8.2 The Lessee shall pay all parking and congestion charges incurred while a Vehicle is in its possession.

question: Which party pays the vehicle excise duty (road tax) on the leased Vehicles?

# Legal Translation Services Agreement

Between Lexicon Bridge Translations Ltd (the "Translator") and Ormond & Pryce LLP (the "Firm").

## 2. Services

2.1 The Translator shall procure that every translation is reviewed by a second qualified linguist before delivery.

2.2 Certified translations will be delivered within five (5) Business Days of receipt of the source documents.

2.3 The Firm agrees to pay the Fees in pounds sterling.

2.4 The Translator must not use machine translation for any document marked "Privileged".

2.5 The Translator may decline any assignment exceeding 20,000 words.

## 3. Fees

3.1 The Fees are set out in Schedule 2.

3.2 An urgent surcharge of 25% applies to any assignment delivered within 24 hours.

question: What is the per-word rate charged for certified translations?

documents.text:
# Electricity Supply Agreement

This Agreement is made between Northwind Power Ltd (the "Supplier") and Calder Mills plc (the "Customer").

## 2. Supply

2.1 The Supplier shall deliver electricity to the Supply Point continuously during the Supply Period.

2.2 The Customer may nominate a revised Annual Consumption once in each Contract Year.

2.3 The Customer must not resell any electricity supplied under this Agreement to a third party.

## 3. Charges and Payment

3.1 Invoices shall be paid within 30 days of the invoice date.

3.2 If the Customer fails to pay any undisputed invoice by its due date, the Supplier may charge interest at 4% above base rate.

question: What can the Supplier charge if the Customer pays an undisputed invoice late?

documents.text:
# Stage Production Agreement

This Agreement is between Lumen Stageworks Ltd (the "Producer") and Kestrel Music Festival CIC (the "Organiser").

## 3. Build and Load-Out

3.1 The Producer shall install and test all rigging and deliver the signed load calculations to the Organiser by 18:00 on 3 July 2027.

3.2 All load-out works must be completed no later than 7 July 2027.

3.3 Notwithstanding clause 3.1, the Organiser may require the Producer to suspend works during periods of high wind.

3.4 The Producer shall use all reasonable endeavours to minimise noise from sound checks before 10:00.

3.5 The Organiser shall not grant access to the stage to any person not holding a valid crew pass.

question: What are the deadlines for delivering the signed load calculations and for completing load-out?
